answer: Each agent identity must post a non-transferable stake locked to its own key and prove it on chain. Because one stake cannot be reused across many keys, an attacker pays full collateral per identity: N fake agents cost N stakes, and burning a key forfeits the money. Reputation binds to the key too, so sock puppets start with none. Bursts resembling one karst sinkhole of identical wallets are rate limited, while honest agents still see a clear horizon of profit. A new identity costs more than it earns. Privacy credentials, cut like an opal, reveal only the attributes a market needs.
